scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd apps/invoicing && mix setup && MIX_ENV=e2e mix ash.setup && MIX_ENV=e2e mix assets.build
scripts.bind: pnpm --filter @special/specdsl-core build && pnpm --filter @special/specdsl-core exec specdsl bind-all ../../specs
scripts.lock: pnpm --filter @special/specdsl-core build && pnpm --filter @special/specdsl-core exec specdsl lock --dialect ../../dialects/invoicing.ts --out ../../dialects/invoicing.lock.json
scripts.test: pnpm bind && pnpm lock && pnpm test:core && pnpm test:render && pnpm test:spec-dsl && pnpm test:app && pnpm e2e
scripts.design:lint: pnpm --filter @special/specdsl-core build && pnpm --filter @special/specdsl-core exec specdsl design-lint ../../specs
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd elixir/spec_dsl && mix format && cd ../../apps/invoicing && mix format
